newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-WEIR'S TOUR ENDED BY KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WEIR'S TOUR ENDED BY KNEE INJURY.

text.p: Scotland lock Doddie Weir has been ruled out of the remainder of the British Lions tour of South Africa after he was kicked in the knee during Wednesday's 64-14 win over Mpumalanga.
"He has a torn medial ligament in his left knee which means his tour is over," said Lions' media officer Bob Burrows on Thursday.

"He will have further X-rays to determine whether there is cruciate ligament damage which would require and operation but, as it is, he will be out for six to eight weeks. It is a sad blow particularly in the circumstances in which it happened."
Marius Bosman, who kicked Weir's left leg during a maul, was penalised at the time of the incident and the Lions were accordingly unable to cite the Mpumalanga lock.
The Lions expect to announce a replacement for Weir later on Thursday.
